prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop website direction comp, 16:10 landscape, first viewport plus a visible beginning of the second section
Primary request: Design the category-standard premium natural ecommerce homepage for the Brazilian brand "Medicina Sagrada", executed at exceptional professional quality. This is the familiar standing alternative, not the recommended direction.
Structure: clean white header with the Medicina Sagrada brand name, navigation "Rapé", "Sananga", "Artesanato", "Etnias", "Nossa história", search and cart; a polished full-width documentary Amazon forest hero with a dark green overlay, left-aligned offer, one orange catalog CTA, and a restrained product still-life on the right; immediately below, a clean warm-neutral section with seven circular photography categories labeled "Huni Kuin", "Shawãdawa", "Kuntanawa", "Nukini", "Yawanawa", "Apurinã", "Shanenawa", plus a right-side shortcut "VER TODAS AS ETNIAS →".
Exact hero text: "Medicinas indígenas originais, direto da floresta."
Exact supporting text: "Conheça produtos de diferentes povos e histórias de origem."
Exact CTA: "ENTRAR NO CATÁLOGO"
Visual system: refined premium natural ecommerce, familiar and trustworthy, strong photography, impeccable spacing, clear cards and controls, minimal decorative language.
Palette: #17401D deep green, #248C34 green, #EF492B orange CTA, #A3250F deep red detail, #F4F0E6 warm neutral.
Typography: distinctive clean contemporary sans display and highly legible sans body; no high-contrast serif.
Composition: obvious ecommerce hierarchy, large hero photograph, accessible CTA, balanced circular category row, sophisticated but conventional.
Image ethics: do not invent Indigenous portraits, body paint, clothing, symbols, or tribal patterns. The circles use only landscapes and craft-detail placeholders, later replaced with real authorized photography.
Constraints: no fabricated reviews, prices, certifications, badges, health claims, discounts, or impact numbers. No mystical smoke, mandalas, generic decorative leaves, gold luxury styling, glassmorphism, gradients, watermarks, browser chrome, device frame, or explanatory notes outside the website. Render as a polished website screen with crisp UI text.
